overall_goal: Serve the carrot soup into a bowl and prepare to eat it

goals.description: Retrieve a ladle from the drawer
goals.rationale: The person puts down the bowl to free their hands, opens a drawer, takes out a ladle, and closes the drawer.

goals.description: Portion the soup from the pot into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person uses the ladle to scoop and stir the soup, pouring it into the bowl before resting the ladle and putting the bowl down.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon and carry the served soup
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer, successfully grabs a spoon after dropping it once, places it in the bowl, and carries the meal away to eat.
